data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 gross claims outstanding opened at $515.1m (prior year). Using the gross claims development triangle the Syndicate records a small favourable prior-year development of $4.2m (a release), driven by favourable emergence on the 2020 underwriting year. The Syndicate continues to be impacted by US catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Ian in 2022 and Winter Storm Uri / Hurricane Ida in 2021) which primarily affected property exposures, while management also recognised an explicit inflation uplift to technical provisions for 2022.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2021 catastrophe ratio included US Winter Storm Uri and Hurricane Ida, which contributed 8.3% and 9.0% to the net claims ratio, respectively.
an explicit uplift of 2.9% or $16.9m, of net technical provisions has been allowed for (2021: nil).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year column). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross earned ultimate changes for UW 2020: 573.8 -> 569.6 = -4.2), because no dedicated "movement in prior years' provision for claims outstanding" gross figure was explicitly tabulated. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). Page numbering is taken from the parsed document headings; minor uncertainty exists around exact printed page numbers for some underwriting-year narrative references.
